title: ObjectType
description: Source description of an OPC-UA ObjectType for ModelDesign XML generation.

name.description: The name of the ObjectType (e.g. MotorType).

variable.description: The list of variables found in the ObjectDesign modelization.

ScalarDataType.description: OPC-UA scalar datatypes that can be used for variables. The set of types has been chosen arbitrarily.

Variable.description: Represents the modelization for a variable member of an ObjectType.

access_level.description: The access level of the variable.

array_dimensions.description:
A list of [array dimensions] for the variable.

data_type.description: The OPC-UA data type of the variable.
